about: The Black Marsh soundtrack: one original piece per role of a classic open-world RPG score (theme, 8 exploration, 7 battle, 3 stings). docs/design/music.md. Each prompt = the shared style + the piece's axes. Audio is generated, never committed; tools/newworld/music/generate.py keeps the manifest.
style: Original instrumental game soundtrack for a tropical swamp jungle province of reptilian people. Shared palette: breathy cane reed flutes, plucked wooden tongue-drum and thumb-piano tones, hollow log drums, bone and wooden clackers, conch shell horns, low bowed strings and a deep sustained drone, wordless low throat-singing and humming choir (no words, no lyrics). Recurring signature motif: a four-note call that rises a perfect fourth, then falls a half step and a whole step and holds. Production: warm, spacious, humid reverb like a canopy at night, analog warmth, no modern synths, no electric guitar, no drum kit, no lyrics, cinematic and organic.

pieces.axes: Main title theme. Majestic and ancient, slow build from solo reed flute stating the four-note call over the drone to full low strings, log drums and wordless choir carrying the call in broad unison. 70 BPM, D minor (dorian colour). Lead: reed flute then massed low strings. Awe at a living, breathing marsh.

Exploration, morning mist over still black water. Very slow and spacious, long silences, drone and soft thumb-piano, the call heard once softly mid-piece. 60 BPM, A minor. Lead: plucked wooden thumb-piano. Mood: hushed, patient.

Exploration under the green rainforest canopy, gentle forward motion, light hand percussion of wood and seed rattles, flute melody that answers the call. 84 BPM, E dorian. Lead: breathy cane flute. Mood: curious, warm.

Exploration along a slow wide river, flowing arpeggios on plucked wood, cello line in long phrases, the call in the cello. 76 BPM, G major (mixolydian colour). Lead: solo cello. Mood: journeying, hopeful.

Exploration near an ancient sacred tree, reverent and mysterious, layered humming choir chords, low drone, sparse bone chimes, the call sung softly. 56 BPM, C minor. Lead: wordless humming choir. Mood: sacred, dreamlike.
Exploration on a warm sea coast, open and bright, conch shell horn phrases, swaying 6/8 log drum, the call on the conch. 90 BPM, F major. Lead: conch horn and flute. Mood: open, windswept.

Exploration on dry mesa highlands above the swamp, sparse, stark, plucked low strings and a lone fretless bowed fiddle, wide intervals, the call stretched slowly. 66 BPM, B phrygian. Lead: bowed folk fiddle. Mood: lonely, vast.

Exploration at tropical night, insect-like soft wooden rattles, deep drone, distant low throat-singing, the call on a low flute very quietly. 58 BPM, F sharp minor. Lead: low bass reed flute. Mood: dark, warm, a little uneasy.

Exploration in warm rain over a bayou, gently pattering wooden percussion, thumb-piano and flute duet, the call traded between them. 72 BPM, D dorian. Lead: thumb-piano and flute duet. Mood: melancholy, tender.
Battle music. Fast pounding log drums and bone clackers in 7/8, stabbing low strings, the call shouted by conch horns. 140 BPM, D minor. Lead: log drums and conch. Mood: sudden danger.

Battle music. Relentless driving hand drums, ostinato low strings, aggressive rhythmic throat-singing grunts without words, the call in the strings. 128 BPM, E minor. Lead: driving low string ostinato. Mood: predatory chase.

Battle music. Heavy slow-hitting giant drums, dark brass-like horn swells from conch, menacing drone, the call low and slow. 100 BPM, C sharp minor. Lead: giant drums and low horns. Mood: monstrous, heavy.
Battle music. Quick nimble wooden percussion and shrill reed flute runs, pizzicato strings, the call fast on flute. 150 BPM, A minor. Lead: shrill reed flute. Mood: frantic skirmish.

Battle music. Martial war chant energy, massed wordless chanting choir on vowels, war drums, strings tremolo, the call as a rallying cry. 120 BPM, G minor. Lead: massed wordless choir. Mood: heroic, defiant.
Battle music. Churning, splashing water-like percussion of hollow gourds and wood, swirling string runs, the call in low reeds. 132 BPM, B minor. Lead: swirling strings. Mood: chaotic, drowning.
Battle music. Desperate and epic, building drums and full low strings with choir swelling, the call at full force at the climax. 136 BPM, F minor. Lead: full ensemble. Mood: desperate last stand.
A short triumphant sting about ten seconds long: the four-note call on conch and flute over one log-drum hit and a bright string chord, then silence. D major.
A short mournful sting about twelve seconds long: the four-note call slowed on low reed flute over a fading drone and a single low drum, then silence. D minor.
A short wondrous sting about ten seconds long: shimmering thumb-piano and humming choir rising into the four-note call, one soft drum, then silence. A major.
